start_line.description: First line, default or zero means 1.

end_line.description: Last line, default or zero means end of file.

max_bytes.description: Source UTF-8 byte cap after line selection, before line-number prefixes; default or zero means 32768. Truncation is reported; prefixes are not file content.

ai_callback_delay.description: Seconds before waking; default 3, zero immediate. Does not cancel.

max_output_bytes.description: Positive inline report cap; default 16384. Full output stays on disk.
